title: Capacity-to-Cost breakpoints: hiring buckets grid Q3 2026
summary: One-page working sheet that maps discrete hiring buckets to unit price breakpoints and runway impact. Includes 7 plausible scenarios (base / downside / upside) with rough P&L lines and an explicit break-even price per 1k tokens given staffing mixes and GPU cost assumptions. Purpose: provide quick guardrails for pricing experiments and hiring cadence decisions when capacity or margin targets change.
sheet_rows: Scenario,Monthly Active Tokens (1k units),Price per 1k tokens (USD),Hosted revenue (k USD),Dedicated revenue (k USD),Total revenue (k USD),Engineering hires (FTE),SRE hires (FTE),Infra hires (FTE),GPU hours/month (k),GPU cost/month (k USD),Other infra & license (k USD),Total opex (k USD),EBITDA (k USD),Margin (%)
assumptions: Token units are in '1k tokens' — e.g., 12000 = 12,000 * 1k tokens = 12M tokens/month
Hosted revenue assumed to be 10% of total token revenue in conservative/varies by scenario (quick proxy) — split modeled, not authoritative
GPU cost assumes average $1.5 per GPU hour in current cloud region; optimize-quantize reduces effective GPU hours by approx 30%
Hiring costs: averaged fully-burdened cost per engineer = $30k/month (salary+taxes+benefits+tools), SRE = $35k/month, infra professional services = $20k/month per FTE equivalent
Other infra & license includes network, storage, monitoring, KMS at roughly 30–50k depending on scenario
This sheet purposefully keeps simplifications — use as tactical guardrail for pricing/commit decisions; follow-up detailed model required for contract negotiations
sensitivity_highlights: Break-even unit price is highly sensitive to two levers: engineering hiring cadence (+/- 2 FTE shifts margin by ~10–18 percentage points) and GPU-hour pricing (+/- 20% change moves EBITDA by ~40–80k/month in base bucket)
Applying quantization/kv-prefix caching (modeled as 30% GPU hour reduction) narrows the required price floor by roughly $0.10–0.20 per 1k tokens in the mid-range scenarios
Burst commits reduce unit GPU cost but increase fixed opex (headcount + reserved infra) — useful if committed throughput is >1.2x baseline
Price drops of 10–20% materially increase required margin-protecting hires or cut discretionary infra spend to avoid negative EBITDA
break_even_table: Staffing profile,Effective monthly FTE cost (k USD),GPU cost baseline (k USD),Break-even price /1k tokens (USD)
